retrieval_evaluation.evidence: Screenshot shows target clauses ranked first for visible evaluation cases; the initial invoice-query CLI output favored the subscription-term clause over the fees/invoicing clause.

latest_ranking_refinement.change: Reduced clause-title bonus and increased content overlap signal for reranking.
latest_ranking_refinement.added_regression_test: Invoice due-date query must rank Clause 4.1 — Fees and Invoicing first.

implemented_capabilities: Markdown and text contract ingestion with clause metadata
Lexical reranking with title and content overlap
Optional Sentence Transformers dense embedding retrieval
Clause-level citations and abstention when no indexed terms match
CLI and synthetic legal retrieval evaluation
limitations: The included agreements are fictional and do not state actual legal requirements.
Default vector search is TF-IDF and lexical; optional embedding and cross-encoder modes require downloading a model.
Retrieval metrics use a small hand-authored query set and do not evaluate legal correctness.
The project does not provide legal advice or assess enforceability.
